purpose: Adversarially audit only the frozen validated Codex result, waiver-aware comparison and synthesis plan without acquiring new research facts.
post_audit_holds: Claude and Grok absence remains visible and confidence remains medium.
Request, plan, physical execution, observation, posting, resulting balance, correction and reconciliation remain distinct.
Inventory position remains a required reference and the registered parent signal remains under review.
Product, lot, serial, handling unit, location, order, task, shipment, trace, ledger, document and evidence remain external masters.
Authoritative posting, reversal and resulting balance remain controlled by the external inventory master or ledger.
Physical transfer, ownership, custody, status, valuation and accounting effects cannot be inferred from one another.
Industry, jurisdiction, safety, accounting, valuation, privacy, licensing and conformance profiles remain deferred.
Every external projection remains version-pinned, access-controlled and loss-declaring.
audit_findings: The event aggregate preserves stable movement identity, assertion kind, revision, subject scope, transition and successor lineage.
Item, lot, serial, handling-unit, position, location, order, task, shipment and ledger records remain typed external references.
Qualified quantity requires unit, precision and scope, while source and destination roles remain explicit.
Planned, effective, event, observation, record, posting and correction clocks remain independent.
Partial, split, merged, failed, reversed and corrected movements preserve append-only evidence and idempotency.
Reconciliation appends differences and conflicts instead of last-write-wins.
Protected projections and privileged mutation are deny-by-default and purpose-bound.
No unresolved critical semantic conflict prevents reviewable-draft publication.
